title: Connect an existing app to Experience Studio

project.description: Target Angular project name. Defaults to the workspace's defaultProject.

catalogUrl.description: Experience Studio catalog service base URL.

tenant.description: Tenant / catalog id the app reads from.

applicationName.description: Which kind:'application' capability this app renders as its shell (optional).

authMode.description: Auth against the catalog: 'disabled' (trusted-network dev) or 'oidc' (forward a bearer token).

authService.description: For OIDC: the app auth service class (implements CatalogAuth) to wire as CATALOG_AUTH.

mode.description: 'registries' populates the lib registries (embed capabilities in an existing app); 'shell' renders the full catalog-driven application.

skipInstall.description: Skip running npm install at the end.
